subject: Edge activation: turnstile / kiosk floorflow and power plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Mike Reynolds <mike@expoops.com>
Cc: orders@clearsign.com
Date: 2026-11-01 09:12 -0700
Subject: Edge activation: turnstile / kiosk floorflow and power plan

Hi team and Mike,

Uploading the latest floorplan (edge_floorplan_v3.pdf) for the CloudCon booth — this thread to coordinate where we place the two demo kiosks relative to the attendee turnstiles and the alternate power feed. We need to finalize by Tuesday so production can ship crates. Key constraints:

- Two demo tablets (lead capture) need uninterrupted power and Wi-Fi — prefer within 10ft of the east feed.
- Turnstile queue will form on the north side; we want a demo sightline without creating congestion.
- Permission from ExpoOps required for any signage that overhangs the aisles (max 8ft mounting).

Questions / asks:
1) Jonas — can you mark where the surge-protected outlets will live on the attached power_feed_map.xlsx and confirm if a 20A split is sufficient for two kiosks + one laptop?
2) Marissa — confirm collateral drop counts and staging area (we have 600 pocket guides, 200 eco-totes).
3) Mike / ExpoOps — can you confirm turnstile clearances and whether we can run a 40ft cable under the carpet to the east feed?

Attachments: edge_floorplan_v3.pdf (application/pdf), power_feed_map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike@expoops.com>, orders@clearsign.com
Date: 2026-11-01 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge activation: turnstile / kiosk floorflow and power plan

Vanessa —

Thanks for the plan. Quick notes after reviewing power_feed_map.xlsx:

- 20A split will be tight. Recommend a dedicated 20A for each kiosk plus a 15A circuit for the laptop stand-by. That keeps the KV cache box and chargers isolated.
- I sketched two alternate routings on the map: route A (under-carpet snake to east feed) and route B (shorter run to central feed + extension). Route B has fewer trip hazards but needs a <2ft riser at the demo counter.
- For staging: recommend we stage the eco-totes in crate #3 (manifest attached) and build a small drop table behind the demo zone to keep lines moving.

Attachment: lead_capture_manifest.csv (text/csv)

If ExpoOps gives the OK for route A we can pre-lay the tape and cable along the north lane during load-in window.

Jonas
Senior Events Tech, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

---

From: Mike Reynolds <mike@expoops.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: orders@clearsign.com
Date: 2026-11-02 08:34 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge activation: turnstile / kiosk floorflow and power plan

Hi Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the early heads up. A few confirmations from ExpoOps: 

- Turnstile clearance: we need a 5ft clear path from the turnstile to any staffed demo area. Your current plan has kiosks at ~4.5ft — please nudge the kiosks 18in to the south to meet code.
- Under-carpet cable runs are permitted but must be flagged with low-profile cable ramps. Route A is allowed; please submit final cable lengths 72 hours before load-in.
- Signage mounting: max 8ft as Vanessa noted. Anything above that requires a permit and additional rigging crew.

We're fine with the 20A dedicated circuits per kiosk as long as they're labeled on the day. I'll confirm final outlet placements in the exhibitor feed once your team picks route A or B.

Also, ClearSign — we received your proof and will allow the 36" hanging panel on the backwall pending flame test.

Best,
Mike Reynolds
Senior Event Operations, ExpoOps
mike@expoops.com

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Mike Reynolds <mike@expoops.com>
Cc: ClearSign Printing <orders@clearsign.com>
Date: 2026-11-03 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Edge activation: turnstile / kiosk floorflow and power plan

Thanks — good confirmations all around. Plan of record:

- We’ll adopt Route A (under-carpet run) with low-profile ramps. Jonas, please send final cable lengths by 2026-11-30 09:00 PT.
- Kiosks shifted 18in south to respect the 5ft turnstile clearance. Updated floorplan attached (edge_floorplan_v3.pdf with redline).
- Power: two dedicated 20A circuits (one per kiosk) + one 15A laptop circuit. Labeling will be handled by on-site techs.
- Collateral: Marissa to confirm the staging table and final counts by EOD Monday. We’ll stage eco-totes in crate #3.
- ClearSign: please proceed with print; confirm flame-test certificate and send a final PDF proof. Orders to: orders@clearsign.com

Next steps / action owners:
- Jonas: final cable lengths & on-site riser plan (due 11/30)
- Marissa: collateral final counts + staging layout (due 11/08)
- Mike: confirm outlet labeling on exhibitor feed (will confirm by 11/10)
- ClearSign: updated proof + flame test cert (ASAP)

Attachments: edge_floorplan_v3.pdf (redline), clearsign_quote_1126.pdf (application/pdf)

I’ll lock the vendor purchase once we have Marissa’s counts and ClearSign’s cert.

Vanessa
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
